plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp boxing S&C build built around one high-value full-body session each week so it supports sparring instead of competing with it. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the primary lower-body lift, then the main program starts in Week 2 with power first, strength second, and brief accessories after. Volume stays conservative because combat load is the priority, and Week 4 trims fatigue so you finish fresher before the next block review.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force and total-body power with simple lifts that do not interfere too much with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep explosive output high while adjusting volume around boxing load.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength work into faster, sharper power and speed without forcing a competition peak.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on cleanly. Step down each rep and keep every jump fast and crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if box setup is awkward. Jump for height and stick the landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and keep ground contact simple and controlled.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop if technique breaks or depth changes.

strengthAssessment.prompt: This session sets your baseline for future percentage work. Warm up progressively, then build to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps and log the load and reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if back squat setup is uncomfortable. Keep the rep test strict and upright.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if available and more comfortable on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Lower with control and drive up hard. Leave 2 reps in reserve on each set.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you prefer a fixed bar path and have a good spotter or safeties.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a harder variation only if all reps stay clean.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull to the lower ribs and pause briefly at the top. Keep the chest glued to the pad.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench for support and avoid twisting through the torso.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral grip and keep the finish controlled.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back, keep the bar close, and stop when hamstring tension is high but spinal position stays solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if barbell setup is crowded or less comfortable.

substitutionOptions.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
substitutionOptions.notes: Hold a plate or dumbbell if bodyweight is too easy.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press

substitutionOptions.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the standing version feels too easy through the torso.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Anti-Rotation Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Hold each rep for 10-15 seconds with steady breathing.

exercises.notes: Keep contacts low and explosive. End the set if jump height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
